verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs explicitly claim real-time bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries, backed by related automation claims (invoice-to-GL coding, approval routing), but this is entirely first-party vendor marketing with no independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync actually working reliably in practice. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation of real-time bidirectional sync specifically, technical details on which ERPs and sync mechanics, and community confirmation that manual journal entries are eliminated rather than reduced.
